response.overview: Ava, an aspiring romance writer in a slump, and David, a sweet but love-shy seatmate who does not believe romance is real, over the course of one Cubs game. After an accidental bleacher meet-cute leaves them stuck together for the game, Ava makes David a promise: before the final out, she will help him find a summer fling inside Wrigley Field. But as Ava turns the ballpark into a rom-com training ground, complete with swings and misses, a makeover, a returning ex and a ninth-inning chase, she starts to realize the story she has been trying to write may be happening right in front of her
response.tagline: Nine Innings to Love follows two young fans who meet in the Wrigley Field bleachers and spark a special connection.
response.title: Nine Innings to Love
